svg.title: MUSTER architecture
svg.desc: Ravi's inert worker claim enters a consequence-sensitive evidence plan, which routes narrow requests to source-owned Employer and Site agents on Cloud Run. Only the Site Agent may read the private raw site evidence in Cloud Storage; the MUSTER Control Plane is denied it by GCP IAM with HTTP 403. Cloud Run and Cloud Storage are regional to asia-south1, while the Vertex AI Gemini 3.7 Flash endpoint the agents call runs at the global location. Gemini 3.7 Flash is invoked locally to each source and interprets that source’s material; deterministic validation and a source signature turn candidate facts into narrow signed attestations. The MUSTER Control Plane checks Q-12 institutional authority, applies pinned policy, analyses consequences, reproduces a deterministic certificate, and keeps durable case and execution state in Cloud SQL. The Action Gate dispatches one action to a synthetic external sandbox rail; the rail commits acceptance and the answer is deliberately lost, so the Gate durably records UNCERTAIN. A fresh Cloud Run process inspects the external system and reconciles the same execution to CONFIRMED with zero redispatch, leaving exactly one external effect. Sandbox only, no real funds. Separately, and drawn dashed because it is not part of the verified Stage-90 cloud execution, an optional local --live claim-intake path lets a Worker Agent running Google ADK with Gemma 4 read Ravi's own narrative and record an unsigned CLAIM_ONLY StatementRecord. That record carries no institutional authority, is never checked by Q-12, and has no decision power; Gemma is not deployed in the verified cloud path.
